purpose: Terrain macro-tile production request/import manifest for the WarlineCapture fictional Gulf FG-L01 map generation pipeline.
builderFallback: If a requested PNG is missing, WarlineCaptureFictionalGulfIsoMapBuilder renders a colored placeholder chunk and reports it as missing macro tile art.

sharedArtDirection.style: premium 2.5D isometric mobile RTS terrain, fictional Gulf coastal city battlefield
sharedArtDirection.camera: fixed isometric gameplay angle matching FG-L01 visual target
sharedArtDirection.lighting: warm upper-left key light, cool readable shadows, crisp terrain silhouettes

outputRequirements.unityTextureUse: Sprite or texture-on-mesh terrain chunk, no mip maps during validation, uncompressed during visual approval
outputRequirements.edgeContract: Roads, curbs, seawall, and sidewalks must align exactly at macro-tile boundaries for matching connector sides.
outputRequirements.contentSeparation: Gameplay buildings, destruction states, units, VFX, health bars, and tactical overlays remain separate runtime layers.

requests.prompt: Create a premium 2.5D isometric terrain macro tile for a fictional Gulf city straight road corridor. Asphalt center road, limestone curbs, sidewalks, palms or shade structures as decorative non-interactive elements, warm upper-left light, clean mobile RTS readability. No units, no gameplay buildings, no UI, no readable text, no flags.

Create a premium 2.5D isometric terrain macro tile for a large fictional Gulf city road intersection. Broad asphalt crossing, limestone curbs, sidewalk bands, subtle lane wear, median palms, decorative markings without readable text. No units, no runtime buildings, no UI, no flags, no health bars.

Create a premium 2.5D isometric terrain macro tile for a friendly civil-defense command plaza in a fictional Gulf coastal city. Empty command building foundation pads, radar/service pads, blue-neutral trim on terrain only, perimeter curb and service road connectors. No baked command building, no turrets, no units, no UI, no readable text, no flags.

Create a premium 2.5D isometric terrain macro tile for a fictional Gulf port edge and seawall. Road along seawall, loading pads, water boundary, concrete edge depth, weathered coastal surfaces, decorative crates only where metadata can mark blockers. No boats, no turrets, no UI, no readable signage, no flags.

Create a premium 2.5D isometric terrain macro tile for an empty seawall coastal-defense battery pad in a fictional Gulf city. Circular or octagonal empty turret foundation, blast walls as terrain, seawall water edge, road connector, warm/cool isometric lighting. No baked turret, no soldiers, no UI, no readable text, no flags.
